prodigal.label: Prodigal
prodigal.description: Predict protein-coding genes in bacterial and archaeal DNA, and export gene coordinates, DNA and translated proteins.
prodigal.argumentsHelp: Start with a Prodigal option, such as -i. Do not include the prodigal program name.

single.label: Predict genes in a genome
single.description: Use the E. coli reference window to learn a gene model and predict coding regions. The proteins remain available for later commands.

meta.label: Predict genes in mixed contigs
meta.description: Use metagenomic mode on reference windows from E. coli and Salmonella. This writes a separate set of predictions.

hmmer.label: HMMER
hmmer.description: Build profile hidden Markov models from alignments and search for related protein or DNA sequences. Start with the supplied globin alignment, then build, prepare and search its profile.
hmmer.argumentsHelp: The first entry selects a HMMER program, such as hmmbuild or hmmscan. Follow it with that program's arguments.

build.label: 1. Build a globin profile
build.description: Build a protein profile from the real globin alignment. Run this before preparing or searching the profile.

press.label: 2. Prepare the profile for scanning
press.description: Create the four indexes needed by hmmscan. The globins.hmm file must already be loaded or built.

scan.label: 3. Scan proteins against the profile
scan.description: Find globin-family matches in the supplied proteins, including human haemoglobin beta. Build and prepare the profile first.

search.label: Search proteins with the profile
search.description: Search the protein collection with the generated globin profile. This uses the uncompressed profile directly.

align.label: Align a protein to the profile
align.description: Align human haemoglobin beta to the generated globin profile and save the Stockholm alignment.

compare.label: Search using a protein sequence
compare.description: Use human haemoglobin beta as a phmmer query against the supplied proteins. No profile-building step is needed.

predicted.label: Compare Prodigal's predicted proteins
predicted.description: After running Prodigal, use phmmer to compare its proteins with one another. Each protein includes a self-match; other matches indicate sequence similarity, not a functional assignment. Keep the Prodigal files loaded.

dna-build.label: Build a DNA repeat profile
dna-build.description: Build a DNA profile from the supplied MADE1 repeat alignment before searching the human chromosome window.

dna-search.label: Search DNA with the repeat profile
dna-search.description: Find MADE1 repeat elements in a real human chromosome 1 window using nhmmer.

stats.label: Inspect the globin profile
stats.description: Display the number of source sequences, profile length and information content of the generated profile.

help.label: Command help
help.description: Show hmmsearch options. Change the first argument to see another HMMER program's help.

prodigal.label: Microbial reference sequences
prodigal.description: Unchanged 60,000-base chromosome windows from E. coli and Salmonella, individually and together. These are real reference sequences for exercising gene prediction, not complete genomes.

hmmer.label: Protein families and a DNA repeat
hmmer.description: Real globin, protein kinase, fibronectin and MADE1 alignments from HMMER's tutorial, protein sequences including human haemoglobin beta and Drosophila Sevenless, and a human chromosome window containing MADE1 repeats.
